nl: 用 Ant Design Vue 做排放监测：查询有监测点、污染物类型（废气/废水）；表格展示监测点、污染物类型、浓度、监测时间；支持新增、编辑、删除。后端返回 { data: [...], perPage: N }。
nlEn: Ant Design Vue emission monitoring: query by monitoring point and pollutant type (waste-gas/waste-water); the table shows monitoring point, pollutant type, concentration, and monitored time; supports add, edit, and delete. The backend returns { data: [...], perPage: N }.
notes: AI-08: { tableData, pageSize } mapping (no total) on the antdv target (antdv/schema)
